resources.string: Local intelligence
Enable OpenJev intelligence
Optional local model scoring. Ordinary typing works when the model is missing or unavailable.
Processing stays on your device. No internet connection or typed-text logs. Passwords, private fields, addresses, and unsupported languages bypass the model.
Context-aware suggestions
Use field information and a short text window to select helpful local suggestions.
Neural autocorrect
Unavailable until correction quality is validated. OpenJev currently offers suggestions only; it never automatically replaces text.
Correction aggressiveness
Conservative is the only available policy. Other modes require separate correction-quality evaluation.
